Help [[Gwen]] recover her misplaced [[Broken Flute|flute]] from the monster-infested riverbanks of [[Lakeside County]].

== Quest information ==

=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
}}
* Gwen does not already have a [[Flute]]. ({{mo}} [[Monk]] characters see [[#Notes|notes]], below, as the quest is slightly different.)

=== Objectives ===
* Find [[Broken Flute|Gwen's Flute]]

=== Reward ===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 1  [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

== Walkthrough ==
{{see|Guide to meeting Gwen}}
Once you get the quest from Gwen, follow the southwest road until you come to the river. Go across it and you should find the Broken Flute on the beach. Return to Gwen for the reward.

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial dialogue ===
; Gwen
: ''"I left my flute by the river, but there are lots of scary monsters there now. I don't know what to do. Can you maybe go and kill them and bring my flute back?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Sure, I can do that.
| decline = No, I don't have time.
| ask = Did you find my '''flute''' yet? I think I left it on the other side of the river.
}}

'''Upon accepting the quest:'''
: ''"Thank you! I can't wait! I know you'll find it!"''

=== Intermediate dialogue ===
; Gwen
: ''"I lost my '''flute'''! I think I left it on the other side of the river, but there are so many monsters there and I'm afraid to go get it. Do you think you could get it for me?" ''

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Gwen
: ''"Thanks for finding my flute.''

: ''"Oh no! It's broken! Now I'm going to have to get a new one."''

== Notes ==
* This quest is mechanically unusual. Rather than having a normal quest window, it is accepted through "normal" dialogue, and the quest reward will be accepted automatically after returning the flute to Gwen.
{{anomaly| If you form a party with anyone who has already started or completed this quest, or has given her the new flute or new cape, then Gwen will ''not'' give you the [[Tapestry Shred]]. Afterwards, everyone that will form a party with you and enter this area will have the same situation.}}
{{anomaly| This quest is ''not'' necessary for  monks to obtain the Tapestry Shred. If you give her the new flute, new cape and flowers, she will give you the Tapestry Shred. If you are in a party with some one doing this quest (giving her the broken flute) after your party member gives her the broken flute and you need to speak to her she will give you the 250 experience points. She will say "Your friend found my flute. Thank You."}}
{{bug|If you abandon this quest, Gwen will not give it again.}}
